notes: The of of Be not ashamed of is the English verb's own required particle, ἐπαισχύνομαι taking the accusative directly, so rule 36's proviso keeps it with the verb; the repeated of before me is the same helper on the coordinated pronoun. 1:16 is analysed the same way (rule 24).

The with of suffer hardship with the gospel was given to the dative article under rule 21, since the ASV writes a determiner for the noun; reading it as the syn- of the compound verb remains defensible.

συγκακοπάθησον is headed on suffer rather than hardship because both English words gloss parts of the compound lexeme, so this is not rule 91's empty support verb; the competing head is recorded in the unit note.
